title: Ops Notebook: interactive, parameterized runbook cells & replayable admin flows
creator: Dana Li
description: Create an interactive "ops notebook" prototype that lets SREs and support engineers author, parameterize, and replay sequences of admin tasks (runbook cells). The goal is a small, ergonomic UI + CLI that records steps, exposes safe input params, validates preconditions, and replays runs against a dry-run environment before executing in production. The notebook will integrate with existing runbook library, runtime telemetry, and RBAC checks.
acceptance_criteria: Notebook can author a sequence of 3+ runbook steps and save as a reusable flow
Cells accept typed parameters with runtime validation and default values
Replay mode runs flows in dry-run using recorded inputs and produces a traceable transcript
Execution requires role check; attempts without permission are blocked and logged
Every run emits structured telemetry (trace id, step durations, success/failure) to the ops console
technical_notes: Prototype as a thin React UI + Node service that persists flows to internal runbook-store
Use existing admin-task API adapter for step execution so we reuse safety guards and idempotency checks
Leverage KV-cache sandbox for replay to avoid writing persistent state during dry-run
Implement optimistic locking on flow edits; store revision metadata for audits
Prefer typed JSON schemas for cell parameters; reuse evaluation harness for validation
